nodes.label: Default Profile (fully local)
nodes.rationale: Nothing in this configuration sends corpus text or questions off the host and no API credential is required. workspace_id default, environment development, JSON logging at INFO. Every value is overridable via OSC_ env vars with double-underscore nesting; running an experiment is copying the file and pointing OSC_PROFILE at the copy.

nodes.label: Answer Model: Ollama qwen3:8b
nodes.rationale: Reached through the OpenAI-compatible adapter. include_usage_in_stream is set because Ollama reports token usage only on the final stream chunk — without it the streaming path (what the API and UI use) records zero tokens for every request, making cost and context-budget analysis impossible.

nodes.label: reasoning_effort: none (Qwen3 thinking disabled)
nodes.rationale: Measured on this deployment: 138 completion tokens with thinking versus 3 without, for the same reply. Off for two reasons — (1) Ollama loads the model with a 4096-token context and thinking competes with the answer for that budget, and an exhausted budget returns empty content rather than a short answer; (2) grounded QA over retrieved passages is mostly extractive, so the latency is not repaid. Set to low or medium to re-enable, raising generation.max_tokens to match.

nodes.label: fast_llm Seam (same model as the answerer)
nodes.rationale: Used only when retrieval.rewrite_queries is enabled. Points at the same qwen3:8b because an 8B local model is already the cheap option and a second distinct model would mean a second model load.

nodes.label: Embeddings: Ollama nomic-embed-text (768-d)
nodes.rationale: Chosen independently of the answer model, which is the point of the separate seam. Changing it changes the vector width and therefore requires a full re-index against a fresh chunks table. nomic-embed-text is a purpose-built retrieval embedder at 768 dimensions, comfortably inside pgvector's 2000-dimension HNSW index limit.

nodes.label: Reranker: noop (deferred until measurable)
nodes.rationale: Off until the evaluation harness can show the gain on OSC's own golden set. Switching to cross_encoder is now safe to measure because min_score is applied to first-stage scores, so enabling a reranker no longer risks discarding everything.

nodes.label: Chunking Sized to the 4096-Token Context (900/120)
nodes.rationale: recursive strategy, chunk_size 900, chunk_overlap 120 — roughly 225 tokens per chunk and five chunks of sources, leaving room for the system prompt and the answer inside the answer model's 4096-token context. Both should be raised if the model is served with a larger context.

nodes.label: Retrieval: hybrid, 30 candidates → top 5
nodes.rationale: strategy hybrid, candidates 30, top_k 5, rrf_k 60, min_score 0.0. These values are tuned by reasoning against the 4096-token budget rather than by measurement, and PROJECT_STATUS.md §8 explicitly labels every retrieval and generation setting here an educated guess.

nodes.label: rewrite_queries: false
nodes.rationale: It resolves follow-up references ('what about the second one?') but costs a second model call on the critical path, and its benefit has never been measured against a golden set. The comment prescribes enabling it together with an evaluation run rather than on its own.

nodes.label: generation.max_tokens 1500, require_citations true
nodes.rationale: Must cover the answer plus any thinking the model does; 1500 keeps the whole request inside a 4096-token context alongside five chunks of sources. require_citations true is the configuration half of the abstention policy.

nodes.label: Default Database and Pool Settings
nodes.rationale: DSN postgresql://mokshdutt@localhost:5432/osc with a 1-10 connection pool — a developer-specific local DSN committed as the default, which is why README documents overriding it with OSC_DATABASE__DSN. This is also the DSN the integration suite shares, per the P1 debt item.
